chunks: God has provision for them of gardens with Streams of running water, where they will abide for ever. This will be the supreme triumph.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of supreme triumph in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Fawz al-Azim* (the Supreme Triumph), emphasizing that true success is not merely entry into Paradise but the eternal proximity to Allah. The imagery of flowing rivers beneath the gardens reflects the Shia understanding of divine grace (*fayd*) sustaining the believers in the afterlife, a reward specifically promised to those who remain steadfast in faith and obedience.
